provenance.thread_title: 规划多 Agent 共享数据实验
provenance.experiment_brewfs_revision: resolve official default branch at execution start; freeze entire campaign

future_rustfs_backend.selection_rule: Deploy RustFS from this required repository and branch for future experiments. At each batch start, resolve and freeze its full commit, build or verify the corresponding image, and record its digest separately from the BrewFS client. Do not silently fall back to another branch or the official latest image. Keep the backend fixed across overlay/packed pairs; dynamic-block comparisons require qualified effective layouts. Preserve historical versions and results.

configurations.name: native
configurations.meaning: basic BrewFS volume; native metadata; no overlay or packing in this contrast

configurations.name: native-overlay
configurations.meaning: overlay over native metadata; fork without packing

configurations.name: native-overlay-pack
configurations.meaning: same overlay over fixed packed lower; mutable/control records still in database

configuration_contract: Author labels, not assumed CLI switches. Qualify actual paths; control object granularity independently. No eight-mode Cartesian product is asserted.

external_comparator.version_source: existing execution repository specification; qualify at execution start

proposed_resources.kernel_page_cache: record separately; bound within per-worker memory; same reset policy

experiments.name: Configuration and semantic qualification
experiments.intervention: Map author configuration names to real frozen entry points; audit clocks, metrics and writes
experiments.baseline_controls: Same source content, durability, budgets and realized object layout
experiments.primary_metrics: mount identity; lower type; runtime path; actual g/B/q; readback
experiments.implementation_gate: Real commands and source/config/image manifest; fork/read-only/migration capability readback
experiments.weakening_outcome: Unsupported path or unmatched semantics excludes the corresponding causal contrast

experiments.name: Overlay overhead and edited-parent fork
experiments.intervention: Add overlay without Packed; compare common operations then equivalent child creation
experiments.baseline_controls: native versus native-overlay; metadata materialization adapter with shared payload; JuiceFS clone
experiments.primary_metrics: ready/first correct operation; durable edit/save; database records; bytes; isolation
experiments.implementation_gate: Edited parent changes inherited by children; isolated writes; remote confirmation
experiments.weakening_outcome: No creation savings or higher everyday overhead; advantage vanishes with fair clone

experiments.name: Retained state and reclamation
experiments.intervention: Increase recoverable state count and delete half
experiments.baseline_controls: Same byte changes, retained version lifetime and payload sharing
experiments.primary_metrics: correctly retained/reopened states; metadata/object byte-time; cleanup lag
experiments.implementation_gate: Recoverable state inventory and reference-safe reclamation
experiments.weakening_outcome: Admission failures; source rows retained; cleanup cannot keep up

experiments.name: Packed access and metadata-service interference
experiments.intervention: Switch fixed lower representation; separately query and run mutable probes
experiments.baseline_controls: Identical frozen content and payload locations, same upper/cache/layout; cold/index-warm/metadata-warm
experiments.primary_metrics: lower/upper/control DB requests; DB CPU/memory/bytes; probe deadlines/p95; object traffic; client CPU
experiments.implementation_gate: Matched fixed-version paths and per-service instrumentation; no automatic source deletion
experiments.weakening_outcome: Warm native or low locality wins; central relief offset by cold object fetches or probe regressions

parameters.rate_reference: lower measured sustainable no-background rate across matched arms; freeze before comparison

experiments.name: First fork and version reuse economics
experiments.intervention: Time from writable source to first useful child and repeated version reuse
experiments.baseline_controls: Native seal/binding versus capture/pack/upload/validate/publish; prepublished reuse separately
experiments.primary_metrics: first-child and batch elapsed; construction CPU/requests/bytes; DB/object byte-time; per-metric cost difference
experiments.implementation_gate: Consistent source capture; exact source retention; no presumed incremental packer
experiments.weakening_outcome: No break-even in measured range, frequent rebuilds, low reuse, or unresolved retained source footprint

parameters.overlapping_phases: time critical path directly; do not sum
parameters.break_even: per resource metric and condition; report all observed crossings, not a universal threshold

experiments.name: Client object size and backend layout
experiments.intervention: Vary g at fixed backend; then B/q on fixed objects/request streams; then fetching policy
experiments.baseline_controls: Same data, code rate, cache/prefetch/coalescing and actual effective geometry
experiments.primary_metrics: object count; HTTP/device bytes; checksum/encoding CPU; durable write; repair traffic; tool time
experiments.implementation_gate: Admitted persisted layouts and instrumented bytes; extensions separately identified
experiments.weakening_outcome: Same effective layout; whole-object verification erases savings; write/repair cost exceeds read savings

parameters.backend_B_q: freeze legal effective values during capability qualification

experiments.name: Partial workspace migration
experiments.intervention: Move selected workspaces at tool boundaries
experiments.baseline_controls: Native/packed separately; no-move paired run; JuiceFS reopen original directory
experiments.implementation_gate: Verified writer handoff and state identity; targets ready; measured node placement
experiments.weakening_outcome: Fast reopen shifts cost to earlier packing; cold target stalls; neighbor interference

experiments.name: Failure and stale-writer validation
experiments.baseline_controls: Same committed-state and stale-writer contract, external termination separately labeled
experiments.primary_metrics: confirmed-state correctness; stale writes; lost/repeated work; recovery outcome
experiments.implementation_gate: Independent reader checks content; actually attempt stale writes
experiments.weakening_outcome: Acknowledged data lost; stale writer succeeds; unsupported takeover

experiments.name: Fixed work replay
experiments.intervention: Run identical 56 assignments at different concurrency
experiments.baseline_controls: Same 7 archives and ordered callback replay; BrewFS versus JuiceFS; qualified internal contrasts separately
experiments.primary_metrics: correct completion curve; makespan if all succeed; per-case latency; resources/cost
experiments.implementation_gate: Single-case final-tree validation; coordinator and common deadline; replay CPU monitored
experiments.weakening_outcome: No useful completion gain; parser bottleneck; failed assigned work

parameters.deadline_scope: prepare + replay + verify, excluding coordinator queue; common observation deadline includes queue
parameters.base_count_scope: native-overlay versus JuiceFS subset; detailed core adds native and packed arms for 36 batches and 2016 replays

experiments.name: Fixed backend with growing client load
experiments.intervention: Increase workers and proportional assigned work
experiments.baseline_controls: Same per-worker CPU/memory/cache and fixed storage budget
experiments.primary_metrics: correct tasks/s; per-case slowdown; metadata/object pressure; assigned failures
experiments.implementation_gate: Actual node placement and 7-case frozen schedule; no inference of fixed-work speedup
experiments.weakening_outcome: Metadata or storage saturates; memory growth; low completion rate

experiments.name: Real session fork and continuation
experiments.intervention: Fork four child sessions or migrate one after third complete tool result
experiments.baseline_controls: Paired no-fork/no-move with same initial task, model and total budget
experiments.primary_metrics: session lineage; first subsequent tool result; grade; model cost; repeated tools
experiments.implementation_gate: Real session API and final grading, not synthetic state-file copy
experiments.weakening_outcome: File replay passes but session cannot continue; budget inflation; no task-level benefit

parameters.remaining_fork_budget: four equal shares of remaining total budget; no reset

statistics.independent_unit: paired batch, not sibling task or request
statistics.initial_summary: paired raw values, median and range
statistics.failures: retain assigned-work denominator and explicit reason; no all-success makespan unless all succeed

accounting.resource_metrics: report units separately; monetary sum only with explicit price/time basis
accounting.retained_source_rows: query offload is not evidence of database storage reclamation
accounting.concurrent_elapsed: measure batch elapsed directly; shared construction counted once
accounting.physical_bytes: null if unavailable, never inferred from HTTP bytes
